The '''Rainbow of Sunshine Festival''' was a [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] celebration. The one in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] was cancelled due to the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
